memory_update.text: ONTO should be tracked as a high-relevance process-control and advanced-packaging candidate for AI leading-edge/packaging bottlenecks; verify revenue mix and backlog quality.
MKSI adds subsystem breadth across vacuum, photonics, lasers and specialty chemicals; relevance is plausible but needs product-level mapping to leading-edge WFE and advanced packaging tools.

This pass did not include OTC/non-US primary listings such as Tokyo Electron or Advantest, nor EDA/IP names such as Synopsys, Cadence and Arm; those should be handled in separate passes if US-listed ADR/EDA/software exposure is in scope.

node: Leading-edge foundry capacity and semiconductor equipment
summary: This pass expands the US-listed universe beyond the obvious foundry and wafer-fab-equipment leaders into second-order but potentially chokepoint-relevant suppliers: process control/advanced packaging inspection, vacuum/photonics/specialty-chemistry subsystems, plasma power supplies, ultra-high-purity subsystem manufacturing/cleaning, and critical gas/fluid delivery modules. These names are more cyclical and often customer-concentrated than the prime equipment OEMs, so the next diligence step is to verify exposure to leading-edge logic, HBM/advanced packaging, EUV-enabled process steps, order backlog, export-control sensitivity, and dependence on AMAT/LRCX/ASML/TSMC/Samsung/Intel capex timing.
